scope: Only the six files changed since the earlier pinned inventory; all six completely read. This does not assert complete review of the other 546 current blobs.

files.decision: Compare pinned, checksum-verified downloads, bounded jobs, nonempty generated outputs, read-only PR validation, explicit Pages opt-in and a serialized noncancelling writer. The new helper retries incomplete Doxygen downloads. Formal AI uses its own renderer and artifact downloader; actual fallback Pages publication and served identity remain unfinished.
Retain as upstream release history. Version 0.2.8 records a retry repair, not proof that Formal AI has adopted every template practice.

Top-level-only tooling options, consumer-minimal defaults and one version source are C++ package choices. Preserve Formal AI Cargo tooling and generated release version contracts; do not add CMake to the Rust package.

Bounded curl retries target a regular file, retry partial transfers, remove terminal failed output, retain fail-on-HTTP errors and pass quoted positional inputs after option parsing ends. This is an applicable archive-download pattern; its adoption across all Formal AI archive downloads is not yet established.

The exact current two tests passed locally against a loopback HTTP server: truncated output is replaced on retry, and repeated HTTP errors fail with no archive. The subprocess has a 12-second test timeout and four finite requests; no external archive or compiler is invoked.
The new package version agrees with CMake 0.2.8 and keeps the exact vcpkg baseline. This is upstream C++ distribution metadata, not a Formal AI dependency update.
